'''Roast bog snarler''' was a meal made from roasted meat. It was one of the dishes served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR Onslaught" />
